changelog:
- Initial release of digital-twin-discharge-drafter.
- Generates AI-powered discharge summaries and structured care plans using digital twin patient models.
- Supports outcome simulation for various post-discharge scenarios to predict readmission risks and optimize interventions.
- Personalizes patient instructions based on health literacy, language, culture, and potential barriers.
- Enables risk-based care planning with automated stratification and targeted interventions.
- Quality assurance features included for completeness, medication accuracy, and readability validation.
